# cargo-zigbuild and the zig it drives, for the aarch64 release binary
# (scripts/build-release.sh). Build tooling only: nothing from it ships.
#
# Exact versions, with the binary-wheel hashes for x86_64 and aarch64
# runners. The release build (release.yml) and the pull-request build
# (rust.yml) both install from this file, so they cannot drift apart:
#   pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: -r .github/zigbuild-requirements.txt
# Bump it deliberately.
